CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL( Discount_Type__c ,'Amount' ) , Unit_Price__c - Discount_Value__c , ((100 - Discount_Value__c ) / 100) * Unit_Price__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If Discount Type is Amount Then Discounted Price = (Unit Rate- Discount Value), Else Discounted Price =((100 - Discount Value) /100) * Unit Rate
CustomField.label: Discounted Price
